components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #8B0000; color: #fff; font-family: 'Readex Pro', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(139,0,0,0.2); transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C62828; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(139,0,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C8A45C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (Gold border)

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: #4a4a4a; font-family: 'Readex Pro', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(200,164,92,0.2); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #8B0000; color: #fff; border-color: #8B0000; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(139,0,0,0.2); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C8A45C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-label { font-size: 0.75rem; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-price { font-weight: 700; } .ds-price small { font-size: 0.625rem; }

components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFBF5, #FFF5E6); border: 1px solid rgba(200,164,92,0.12); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(139,0,0,0.12); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,0,0,0.02), transparent); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-card-inner { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-thumb { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid rgba(200,164,92,0.15); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-thumb-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 2rem; } .ds-card-content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Readex Pro', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; } .ds-price-badge { flex-shrink: 0; background: linear-gradient(to left, rgba(200,164,92,0.2), rgba(200,164,92,0.05)); color: #A8883C; font-family: 'Readex Pro', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(200,164,92,0.15); } .ds-price-badge small { font-size: 0.625rem; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: 'Readex Pro', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #9ca3af; line-height: 1.5; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-actions { margin-top: 12px; } .ds-btn-sm { padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.8125rem; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 50; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-nav-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; } .ds-nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-nav-logo span { font-family: 'Readex Pro', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; color: #8B0000; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Readex Pro', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #4a4a4a; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #8B0000; background: rgba(139,0,0,0.05); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #8B0000; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Lightbox
components.description: Full-screen image lightbox with blur backdrop and scale-in animation.
components.css: .ds-lightbox { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 70; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); padding: 16px; animation: ds-fade-in 0.25s ease-out forwards; } @keyframes ds-fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } .ds-lightbox-close { position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.2s; z-index: 1; } .ds-lightbox-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-lightbox-img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; border-radius: 16px; object-fit: contain; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); animation: ds-scale-in 0.3s ease-out forwards; } @keyframes ds-scale-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }

narrative.overview: The interface carries the generosity of Syrian hospitality — deep crimson warmth, gold accents like candlelight, cream-background comfort. Every surface feels touched by care: card gradients shift subtly, gold catches the eye at interaction points, and the crimson primary appears where action happens. The system rejects fast-food urgency — no countdowns, no garish sale badges, no cheap brights.
keyCharacteristics: Single Arabic-optimized font (Readex Pro) across all roles — weights do the hierarchy work
Warm cream gradient backgrounds with gold diamond pattern overlay as a heritage texture
Crimson primary used decisively on interactive elements, never as a body background
Gold accents as secondary signals — price badges, decorative borders, hover glow
Card shine and hover elevation provide tactile feedback without relying on heavy shadows
Arabic-first layout with RTL as native direction, not a translation adaptation

rules.name: The Hospitality Rule
rules.body: Crimson commands action; gold rewards attention. When a user needs to decide (add to cart, order), use crimson. When they need to feel valued (price, deal, decoration), use gold.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Floor Rule
rules.body: No flat neutral surfaces. Every background is a gradient, subtle enough to feel like a single color but rich enough to avoid flatness.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Readex Pro is the only font family. No pairings, no contrast axes. Hierarchy comes from weight (400 → 500 → 700 → 800) and size alone.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Hover shadows carry the brand hue (crimson at 12%), never neutral gray.

dos: Do use Damascus Crimson for all primary actions (add to cart, order, submit). Gold is the supporting accent.
Do keep the warm cream gradient as the body background.
Do use Readex Pro across all roles. Weight contrast is the sole hierarchy mechanism.
Do tint hover shadows with the brand hue rather than neutral gray.
Do use the card-shine effect on hoverable cards.
Do maintain RTL-native layout: padding, icon positioning, and text alignment designed for Arabic first.
donts: Don't use fast-food visual language — bright primary colors, countdown timers, giant discount badges.
Don't default to dark mode. The interface is warm and cream-based.
Don't strip cultural identity for minimalist convenience.
Don't pair a second font family with Readex Pro.
Don't use flat neutral backgrounds. Every surface has a gradient.
Don't use a generic gray shadow on hover.
Don't put crimson text on a cream background below 14px.
